text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Who knew I'd catch this much~ 
Boat fishing is the best! But man—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Haaah... Waking up at 2 AM is 
seriously rough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... Guess I'll take a little nap... 
on the sofa...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... sleeping in a place like this, 
Sei-chan? You'll catch a cold—
(*Yank, thud... squeezeee!!*)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Um? Geez, is this your usual mischief? 
You startled me, so please let go—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So warm... Hehehe, such a cute kitty...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'—... Wait, what are you two 
doing...?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks to you, I managed to break 
free, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If we leave her like this, it feels like 
it's going to turn into a whole mess...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sky, come on, wake up! If you're gonna 
sleep, go to your room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's it, head straight to your room—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mumble mumble...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Wait, why are you coming towards 
me...!? ...!?
(SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Wh-... what...!? Wait, could this 
be... is this—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (A wall sla—...!?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, backed ya into a corner now~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I get what's going on. Sheesh, 
looks like Sky is completely sleepwalking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I dealt with folks like 
this all the time at my old man's diner! 
At times like this—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Nod... nod...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, she's stopped staggering. Come 
on! Your room is this way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ............ ...How should I put this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...That was certainly an unusual way to 
sleepwalk.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmmghhh~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fwaaah~... What a nice dream that was~. 
Hugging a fluffy kitty like a body pillow, 
playing tag—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Wasn't I sleeping in the 
lobby?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Could it be my homing instinct kicked 
in...? My own talent terrifies me...!

After handing <chrname> their training menu, I was 
walking along when...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer-sa~n over there. Don't 
suppose you're in the mood for some fish 
today?
choice_data_list: What brought this on all of a sudden?
What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, this morning's boat 
fishing was a massive haul! Here, sharing 
a little happiness with you~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, today sure is a great day~. I wonder 
when I should go boat fishing next~♪
